title: 001: Simple Pendulum & a Single Degree of Freedom
description: A deep, interactive exploration of the classic simple gravity pendulum, its dynamics, and the foundational concept of a degree of freedom in physics.

title: 002: The Double Pendulum & Deterministic Chaos
description: Witness how adding just one more degree of freedom transforms a predictable system into a beautiful, unpredictable dance of chaos.

title: 003: Coupled Oscillators & Normal Modes
description: Discover how simple oscillators, when linked together, give rise to collective behaviors like normal modes and beats.

title: 004: Diatomic Molecule - Rotation & Vibration
description: A semi-classical look at the internal degrees of freedom that give molecules their unique spectroscopic fingerprints.

title: 005: Rigid Body Rotation & Euler's Equations
description: Explore the elegant and often surprising 3D tumble of a spinning object, governed by Euler's beautiful equations.

title: 006: N-Body Gravitational Simulation
description: An interactive laboratory for exploring the intricate dance of celestial bodies governed by the universal law of gravitation.

title: 007: Gravitational Wave Polarization
description: Visualizing how ripples in the fabric of spacetime stretch and squeeze matter.

title: 008: Ideal Gas in a Box & Statistical Mechanics
description: From the random motion of individual particles emerge the predictable laws of thermodynamics.

title: 009: The Vibrating String & Fourier's Magic
description: Decomposing complex wave shapes into a symphony of simple sine waves.

title: 010: Frame-Dragging & The Lense-Thirring Effect
description: Visualizing how a spinning mass twists the very fabric of spacetime around it.
